findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "update_spot_facts" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_spots, get_spot, get_zone, ask · Private data: check_in, suggest_spot, add_media_link, update_spot_facts · Public sink: add_media_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_spots, get_spot, get_zone, ask · Private data: check_in, suggest_spot, add_media_link, update_spot_facts · Public sink: add_media_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
